integrity: A self-contained general integral homotopy proof accompanies finite, exact simplicial boundary checks; these finite checks do not themselves prove the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Complete uniform lexicographic clique fibers and n>=7 only; no equivariant representation, noncomplete fiber classification, or independent audit claimed. Unindexed equivalent literature remains a risk.
title: Uniform integral homotopy classification of cyclic clique expansions
